subject: Re: Candidate Alex Gomez — propose split core loop + deep-dive slot
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@talentup.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@talentup.co>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Alex Gomez — senior backend candidate (availability)

Hi Marcus,

Following up on the backend IC role we discussed — Alex Gomez is keen to do a virtual full loop. He's available next week in these blocks (all PST):
- Tue Oct 26: 08:30–11:30 or 13:00–16:00
- Wed Oct 27: 09:00–12:00

Alex is OK with either a single consolidated 3-hour loop or a split approach (core loop + separate deep-dive). His resume is attached. Could you confirm panel composition and any constraints for interviewers?

We'd like to lock times by Friday so he can make travel/availability plans.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Senior Recruiter, TalentUp
Attachments: alex_gomez_resume.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@talentup.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alex Gomez — senior backend candidate (availability)

Thanks Priya — looping in the core interview owners. Quick read: Alex's background looks like a good fit. We have a panel conflict on Tue morning (two interviewers booked on another onsite) so I'm proposing a split loop to avoid compressing panels. Two options:

Option A (same-day split)
- Core loop: 09:30–11:00 (behavioral, system design, cross-team)
- Deep-dive: 11:30–12:30 (backend/DB deep-dive with infra owner)

Option B (next-day deep-dive)
- Core loop: Oct 26 09:00–10:30
- Deep-dive: Oct 27 10:00–11:30

I prefer Option B to give the deep-dive owner time to prepare and avoid interviewer overlap. I've sketched a panel ownership matrix (attached) — we'll need a backend owner who can run the deep-dive. Can laura/mina confirm availability?

Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, Backend Platform — Redwood Inference
Attachments: panel_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alex Gomez — senior backend candidate (availability)

I'm ok with a split. Notes:
- I would prefer the deep-dive the same day if possible (keeps momentum) but only if we can shorten the core loop to ~75 minutes — behavioral (20m), system design (30m), cross-team (25m).
- If we go next-day deep-dive, please make sure the debrief window covers both days. We often lose context on day+1. I can own the debrief doc if someone else runs the deep-dive.

If we shorten the core loop, we should remove the exploratory product discussion from the main slot and move to the follow-up. I'll be available Oct 26 09:00–11:30.

Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Recruiting Operations

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alex Gomez — senior backend candidate (availability)

I can cover backend deep-dive. My availability: Oct 26 morning tied up until 11:00, but Oct 27 10:00–11:30 works great. I'll open the "backend deep-dive" slot and prep a short rubric (DB scaling, latency tradeoffs, profiling).

I attached an updated panel matrix with the swap (panel_matrix_v2.xlsx). Marissa — can you draft the candidate debrief template covering cross-team and execution signals?

Mina Haddad
Staff Engineer, Infra
Attachments: panel_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@talentup.co>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@talentup.co>

Subject: Confirmed: Core loop + deep-dive for Alex Gomez (details & invites)

Hi Priya / Alex — thanks for the flexibility. Final plan below:

Core loop (virtual) — Tue Oct 26 09:30–10:45 PST
- Behavioral: Laura Bennett (20m)
- System design: Marcus Lin (35m)
- Cross-team/product: Marissa Cole (20m)

Deep-dive (virtual) — Wed Oct 27 10:00–11:00 PST
- Backend deep-dive: Mina Haddad (60m)

Action items:
- Priya/Alex: please confirm those two slots. Once confirmed I'll send calendar invites with Zoom links. (Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234)
- Mina: prepare the DB/latency rubric (we'll use panel_matrix_v2.xlsx).
- Marissa: I'll ask you to own the debrief doc and post the first-pass notes within 2 hours of the core loop.

Attachments: alex_gomez_resume.pdf, panel_matrix_v2.xlsx

Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, Backend Platform — Redwood Inference
